release_unit: interop/conformance public contract plus referenced profile/verifier revisions

compatibility.patch: No intentional semantic changes to existing modes or result meanings; fixes may tighten false-positive behavior when the previous behavior violated documented semantics.
compatibility.minor: Additive modes, outputs, vectors, or profile versions; existing documented modes remain available.
compatibility.major: Breaking mode removal, incompatible input/output contract changes, or intentional result-semantic changes.

deprecation.requirement: Deprecated modes must remain declared in the catalog with migration guidance before removal.

pinning.preferred: immutable release tag after a release exists

current_state.note: No conformance release has been published yet; consumers must pin an immutable commit SHA.
